description: Header file defining the AppManager class and its nested Notification class, which implement plugin and app management functionalities within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes interface declarations, external dependencies, and class member definitions related to app lifecycle notifications and plugin management.

classes.name: AppManager
classes.description: Main plugin class managing app lifecycle notifications, plugin interface, and configuration within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: AppManager::Notification
classes.description: Nested class implementing remote connection and app manager notifications, handling events like activation, deactivation, installation, uninstallation, state changes, launch requests, and unloading.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin with the provided shell service.
